# Local test stack for the Companion task actions endpoint (mobile-app#361, #363).
# Not the app's config: its own project id and ports, so it cannot touch the
# default local stack, another worker's stack or any hosted project.
# Started by ../run.sh, which copies the function source into supabase/functions.
project_id = "unify-actions-363"

[api]
enabled = true
port = 60671
schemas = ["public"]
extra_search_path = ["public", "extensions"]
max_rows = 1000

[db]
port = 60672
shadow_port = 60673
major_version = 17

[db.migrations]
enabled = true
[db.seed]
enabled = false

[realtime]
enabled = false
[studio]
enabled = false
[local_smtp]
enabled = false
[storage]
enabled = false
[analytics]
enabled = false

[auth]
enabled = true
site_url = "http://127.0.0.1:3009"
jwt_expiry = 3600
enable_signup = true
minimum_password_length = 6
[auth.email]
enable_signup = true
enable_confirmations = false

[edge_runtime]
enabled = true
policy = "per_worker"
inspector_port = 60674

# A new step under a content-backed task needs its published Checklist document (#366).
# Tests answer that read from 127.0.0.1 (support.ts contentStub); run.sh sets the URL.
[edge_runtime.secrets]
COMPANION_CONTENT_QUERY_URL = "env(ACTIONS_CONTENT_QUERY_URL)"

[functions.companion-actions]
verify_jwt = true
